question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing striker, Bob is playing left back, Claire is playing benchwarmer, Dave is playing right winger, Eve is playing left midfielder, Fred is playing center midfielder, and Gertrude is playing goalkeeper.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Eve and Claire trade positions. Then, Alice and Bob trade positions. Then, Claire and Dave trade positions. Then, Bob and Claire trade positions. Then, Alice and Claire trade positions. Then, Eve and Dave trade positions. Finally, Bob and Dave trade positions. At the end of the match, Fred is playing
Options:
(A) striker
(B) left back
(C) benchwarmer
(D) right winger
(E) left midfielder
(F) center midfielder
(G) goalkeeper
solution:
Player order in every row: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve | Fred | Gertrude.
Initial: striker | left back | benchwarmer | right winger | left midfielder | center midfielder | goalkeeper
1. Eve ↔ Claire: striker | left back | left midfielder | right winger | benchwarmer | center midfielder | goalkeeper
2. Alice ↔ Bob: left back | striker | left midfielder | right winger | benchwarmer | center midfielder | goalkeeper
3. Claire ↔ Dave: left back | striker | right winger | left midfielder | benchwarmer | center midfielder | goalkeeper
4. Bob ↔ Claire: left back | right winger | striker | left midfielder | benchwarmer | center midfielder | goalkeeper
5. Alice ↔ Claire: striker | right winger | left back | left midfielder | benchwarmer | center midfielder | goalkeeper
6. Eve ↔ Dave: striker | right winger | left back | benchwarmer | left midfielder | center midfielder | goalkeeper
7. Bob ↔ Dave: striker | benchwarmer | left back | right winger | left midfielder | center midfielder | goalkeeper
Fred's final position is center midfielder, option (F).
Final answer: (F)
